title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer coun

translated_title: 只关注重要内容：面向长视频目标分割中冻结视觉Transformer的无训练焦点图
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer是视频目标分割中强大但成本高昂的图像编码器。无训练的token合并在整个画面上均匀削减计算量，包括在被跟踪的目标上。我们为经过训练的Cutie头内的冻结DINOv3 ViT提供了一种无需训练的焦点图：在分割器预期目标所在的位置保持全分辨率，而在其他位置进行更粗粒度的合并。仅保护前一帧的掩码在短视频片段上有效，但在长视频上会失效，因为快速运动会把目标推出保护边缘、进入背景合并区域，从而锁定损失。我们的策略改为取速度偏移掩码与块匹配掩码的并集，执行相机补偿的意外性检查，将不确定区域委托给对比的合并方法，并在所有目标丢失时回退到该方法。在长视频上（LVOS V2验证集，预设协议，三个ViT-S随机种子），该方法以少16%的计算量相比ALGM 0.98提升了+2.76 J&F（95%目标级置信区间[+1.22,+4.44]；视频聚类置信区间[+0.99,+4.52]）
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需训练的焦点图策略，通过融合速度偏移掩码与块匹配掩码、相机补偿的意外性检查以及不确定性区域委托机制，使冻结的DINOv3 ViT仅在分割目标预期区域保持全分辨率，在长视频目标分割任务中以更少计算量取得显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a training-free focus map policy that combines velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, camera-compensated surprise checks, and uncertainty delegation, enabling a frozen DINOv3 ViT to keep full resolution only where tracked objects are expected, achieving significant performance gains in long-video object segmentation with 16% less compute.
